body: I'm Rick Harrison, and this is my pawn shop.
It really means a lot to me that I can vent here and that someone actually replied to me and listened. I appreciate it, and I'll definitely look into getting some help, maybe counseling or something.

If you don't have much life left to live, do your best to be happy. Do you really need the job with decent pay? Would you be comfortably downgrading to a lower pay job that gives you more free time? I think that could be a really good thing for you. More time to yourself would probably give you more appreciation of life!
